Applying to AMEF

What to expect when recruitment opens.

Each published vacancy will carry its own requirements. Always rely on the official details shown on this website or confirmed directly by AMEF.

01

Review the role

Read the responsibilities, requirements and location carefully.

02

Prepare your application

Follow the exact document and submission instructions in the vacancy notice.

03

Submit before the deadline

Use only the verified channel and closing date published by AMEF.

Protect yourself from false recruitment.

Do not send money or sensitive documents in response to an unverified vacancy. Confirm every opportunity directly with AMEF.
